name: Mobile Developer
description: Builds and maintains application delivery capabilities within the Technology & Engineering value stream, contributing to data pipeline CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and environment lifecycle management. Maintains Helm chart libraries, retires deprecated IaC modules, and configures automated secret rotation. Supports cloud security posture management and CMDB governance through weekly posture dashboards and post-deployment debriefs.

name: Model Risk Analyst
description: Performs model and AI risk assessments across the Data & AI value stream, evaluating generative AI use cases against guardrails and red-teaming LLM applications. Maintains the AI policy framework, executes algorithmic fairness testing and model explainability work, and supports AI regulatory reporting and examinations, mapping controls to NAIC Model Bulletin expectations via the GRC platform.

name: Model Risk Manager
description: Oversees model risk management within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, sustaining policy governance, the risk appetite framework, and risk taxonomy maintenance. Supports market conduct examinations by fulfilling document production and driving corrective-action plans to closure. Manages TPRM intake, assigning vendor risk tiers, and triages compliance issues through the compliance register.

name: Network Administrator
description: Administers network and infrastructure services within the Technology & Engineering value stream, covering certificate management, web application firewall management, and secret rotation policies. Maintains infrastructure-as-code and environment lifecycle standards, migrating consumers to approved module versions. Supports cloud security posture management and CMDB governance, producing weekly posture dashboards and reporting drift trends to governance.

name: New Business Case Manager
description: Coordinates new business casework across the Underwriting value stream, supporting policy binding, mid-term endorsement processing, and replacement suitability review. Administers the reinsurance program, screening treaties for retention, referring over-retention cases, and submitting bordereaux to treaty reinsurers. Supports underwriting quality assurance and appetite exception tracking, revising and re-issuing quotes to brokers with negotiated terms.

name: Operational Resilience Analyst
description: Performs operational resilience analysis within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, identifying resilience vulnerabilities and defining important business services. Conducts business impact analyses, maps critical service dependencies against impact tolerances, and executes BCM testing, documenting results and raising remediation actions. Supports IT disaster recovery planning and incident response governance, maintaining runbooks and pre-approved communication templates.

name: Operational Resilience Lead
description: Leads the operational resilience program within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, directing BCM programme governance, testing, and resilience vulnerability identification. Drives business impact analysis and important business service definition, assessing dependencies against impact tolerances and developing remediation investment plans. Oversees IT disaster recovery planning, incident response governance, and crisis communications, including post-crisis reviews.

name: Operational Risk Manager
description: Manages operational risk within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, maintaining the risk appetite framework, risk taxonomy, and policy governance. Supports market conduct examinations through document production and corrective-action plans tracked to remediation. Runs TPRM intake, capturing vendor inherent-risk profiles and assigning risk tiers, and triages compliance issues while producing risk reporting for governance.

name: Operations Manager
description: Oversees policy operations performance within the Corporate Operations value stream, driving workforce capacity planning, vendor service management, and process improvement. Monitors real-time workload against staffing, triggers load-balancing for queue imbalances, and forecasts transaction volumes by function. Manages vendor performance reviews and remediation plans, reviews SOC 2 certifications, and assesses regulatory change impact on operations.

name: Operations Specialist
description: Performs high-volume policy servicing across the Business Operations value stream, executing policy issuance, renewals, cancellations, and term conversion processing on the policy administration system. Handles suitability reviews, annuity application good-order checks, and 1035 exchange funding. Reconciles subaccount unit values, resolves beneficiary designation conflicts, processes plan installations and audit adjustments, and responds to auditor requests.

name: Organizational Change Manager
description: Leads learning and change delivery within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, developing learning content and publishing approved courses to the LMS with targeted learning paths. Administers mandatory training compliance, mapping requirements to frameworks and courses, and tracks certifications and producer licensing, flagging licenses at risk of lapse. Supports leadership development, coaching, and CE compliance reporting.

name: PMO Analyst
description: Performs portfolio analysis and quality assurance within the Program Management Office value stream, validating program RAG ratings against delivery evidence and tracking benefit realization against business cases. Maintains the delivery methodology and lessons-learned repository, assessing project compliance with delivery standards. Supports audit readiness and compliance reporting, remediating audit findings to closure and publishing the annual Portfolio Performance Report.

name: PMO Manager
description: Manages program governance spanning the Risk, Compliance & Audit, Human Resources & Talent, and Data & AI value streams alongside core PMO delivery. Leads executive portfolio governance reviews and modernization planning, building business cases and securing funding approval. Supports market conduct examination responses and control framework design, drafting examiner-finding responses and tracking corrective-action remediation to completion.
